name: we3studio-photoprinting
description: We3Studio - Professional Photo Printing Web Application

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd photoprintx/backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.deploy:vercel: cd photoprintx/frontend && ng build --configuration production && vercel --prod
scripts.deploy:heroku: cd photoprintx/backend && git subtree push --prefix=photoprintx/backend heroku main

author: gowrishankar10
